name: Span wall
description: Adds a Span layout mode to the Wallpapers tab: one wallpaper stretched over the whole virtual desktop, each screen showing its slice, instead of per-screen crops. A layout dropdown sits right of the content filters. Per-screen wallpaper pins are kept and restored when you switch back.
author: EliasLd
permissions: Reads the Quickshell screen layout to compute the spanning geometry
Persists the layout mode through Ambxst's mod settings
